title: Unique descent of tensor comparison from representatives
statement: For categories K,H,D,E, functors q:K→D, qprime:H→E, F:K→H, LF:D→E, and epsilon:q LF→F qprime, let P,S be representative full subcategories preserved by F. Assume restriction along (P→K→D) squared is fully faithful, tensor representative isomorphisms r and rprime are given, and b:t F≅(F×F)tprime. If epsilon is invertible on P and on tensors of pairs in P, there exists a unique natural isomorphism T LF≅(LF×LF)Tprime satisfying the representative square.

source.place: Tags 04VI--04VK, localization universal property; application in sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A4

proof.text: Compose r inverse, epsilon on the tensor, b, rprime, and the inverse epsilon maps on both factors to obtain a natural isomorphism after restriction.

Lift that isomorphism through fully faithful restriction. Cancellation proves its representative square. Restriction is faithful and the outside maps are invertible, so the square determines the lift uniquely.

proof_origin.note: Representative descent argument following the cited localization and derived pullback constructions.

theorem tensorComparisonDescent
    {K : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} K] {H : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} H]
    {D : Type u₃} [Category.{v₃} D] {E : Type u₄} [Category.{v₄} E]
    (q : K ⥤ D) (q' : H ⥤ E) (F : K ⥤ H) (LF : D ⥤ E)
    (eps : q ⋙ LF ⟶ F ⋙ q')
    (P : ObjectProperty K) (S : ObjectProperty H)
    (hF : ∀ X, P X → S (F.obj X))
    (ff : ((whiskeringLeft (P.FullSubcategory × P.FullSubcategory) (D × D) E).obj
      ((P.ι ⋙ q).prod (P.ι ⋙ q))).FullyFaithful)
    (t : K × K ⥤ K) (t' : H × H ⥤ H)
    (T : D × D ⥤ D) (T' : E × E ⥤ E)
    (r : (P.ι.prod P.ι) ⋙ t ⋙ q ≅ ((P.ι ⋙ q).prod (P.ι ⋙ q)) ⋙ T)
    (r' : (S.ι.prod S.ι) ⋙ t' ⋙ q' ≅ ((S.ι ⋙ q').prod (S.ι ⋙ q')) ⋙ T')
    (b : t ⋙ F ≅ (F.prod F) ⋙ t')
    (he : ∀ X, P X → IsIso (eps.app X))
    (het : ∀ X Y, P X → P Y → IsIso (eps.app (t.obj (X, Y)))) :
    ∃! a : T ⋙ LF ≅ (LF.prod LF) ⋙ T',
      ∀ (X Y : K) (hx : P X) (hy : P Y),
        LF.map (r.hom.app (⟨X, hx⟩, ⟨Y, hy⟩)) ≫ a.hom.app (q.obj X, q.obj Y) ≫
            T'.map (Prod.mkHom (eps.app X) (eps.app Y)) =
          eps.app (t.obj (X, Y)) ≫ q'.map (b.hom.app (X, Y)) ≫
            r'.hom.app (⟨F.obj X, hF X hx⟩, ⟨F.obj Y, hF Y hy⟩)
